features.name: IL intensity
features.line: IL intensity: the lamp's intensity step per channel, set in LAS X; a higher step is more light and more bleaching.
features.seenInFiles: 17 of 17 DM5500B .lif images (LAS X 3.4.2): step 3 on the A4 cube, 4 on Y5, in every image.

features.name: Exposure and gain
features.line: Exposure and gain: set per channel in LAS X, and kept per image, so images of one session can differ.
features.seenInFiles: 17 of 17 DM5500B .lif images: DFC365 FX camera; exposure 0.12-0.25 s and gain 1-3.1 differ between images of one session.

features.name: Binning
features.line: Binning: set on the camera in LAS X; 2x2 halves the pixel count each way and doubles the pixel size.
features.seenInFiles: 17 of 17 DM5500B .lif images: 2x2 binning, 696x520 pixels, 12 bit; 1.02 um pixels with the 20x/0.50 objective.
